fullPassage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.

questions.passage: ①It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. ②Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more draining and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. ③Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. ④For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분을 포함하는 것은?

det.korean: ② draining(진을 빼는) → energizing(활력을 주는): 깊은 의미를 찾은 사람은 나날을 더 '활력 있게' 느낌
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 일치: 의미 있는 일의 중요성은 과장하기 어렵다는 내용
✅ ② draining → energizing: 원문은 'much more energizing and satisfying'(더 활력 있고 만족스러운)이나 'draining'(진을 빼는)으로 바뀌어 의미가 정반대 ←정답
❌ ③ 원문 일치: 일에 가장 만족하는 사람이 더 행복하다는 내용
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 더 큰 만족을 얻은 사람이 150퍼센트 더 행복하다는 연구 내용
det.tip: energizing(활력을 주는) ≠ draining(진을 빼는)

questions.passage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 본문에 따르면, 의미 있는 일이 권한 부여(empowerment)와 함께 제공하는 것을 본문에서 찾아 영어 3단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: sense of fulfillment = 성취감
det.analysis: 본문 S1 'work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment'에서 의미 있는 일이 권한 부여와 함께 제공하는 것은 sense of fulfillment(성취감)이다. 3단어: sense / of / fulfillment.
det.tip: stem 단서: '권한 부여와 함께 제공하는 것' = (a) sense of fulfillment

det.tip: stem 단서: '더 높은 품질의 일과 함께 만들어내는 것' = (a) greater output

questions.passage: Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more __________ (energize) and satisfying. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: satisfying과 and로 병렬되는 현재분사형 형용사 energizing (활력을 주는)
det.analysis: 'much more __________ and satisfying'에서 뒤의 현재분사형 형용사 satisfying과 and로 병렬되는 자리이므로, 동사 energize가 아니라 현재분사형 형용사 energizing이 와야 한다. energize → energizing
det.tip: energizing and satisfying = 활력을 주고 만족스러운 (현재분사형 형용사 병렬)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 의미 있고 만족스러운 일이 성취감·생산성·소득·삶의 행복에 미치는 영향을 설명
det.analysis:
❌ ① 직업 선택법: 소득은 한 근거일 뿐 직업 선택법이 주제가 아님

❌ ③ 직장 생활 관리 기술: 관리 기술은 본문에서 다루지 않음
✅ ④ 의미 있는 일이 삶의 행복에 미치는 영향: 의미 있고 만족스러운 일이 성취감·생산성·소득·삶의 행복을 높인다는 글 전체 논지 ←정답
